## The problem

What friction or gap are you hitting? What can't you do today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. If it's a new skill/hook, sketch what it does and when it fires.

## Keeping it lean

harness-claude is deliberately minimal. Why does this earn a place rather than being
handled by an existing skill/hook, or left to the user's own setup?

## Alternatives considered

Anything you've tried or ruled out.

## Roadmap fit (optional)

Does this align with a phase in [ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md)? Which one?
